queue.claim: In ARKit, 'Left' blendshapes (eyeBlinkLeft and similar) refer to the subject's own left, as MediaPipe's do. In Blender (character facing -Y) they map to the +X side.
queue.query: ARKit eyeBlinkLeft user's left eye or right eye front camera mirrored blendShapes

queue.claim: Blender's FBX and glTF exporters ignore a shape key's vertex_group mask and non-Basis relative_key (and FBX can drop shape keys when non-Armature modifiers are applied), so these must be baked before export.
queue.query: Blender glTF FBX exporter shape key vertex group relative key ignored morph target export
